close_reason: Fixed in 5e18f72: README 'What it's for' now cites RFC 9610 instead of the stale 'RFC 6889 / draft-ietf-jmap-contacts' string.
description: crate-jmap-contacts-types/README.md line 33 reads: 'RFC 6889 / draft-ietf-jmap-contacts data types'. RFC 6889 is 'Analysis of Stateful 64 Translation' (NAT64). This crate covers RFC 9610 (JMAP Contacts). The 'draft-ietf-jmap-contacts' label is also stale — RFC 9610 superseded that draft. Trigger: any reader skimming the 'What it's for' section. Bad behavior: confusion / loss of confidence in the rest of the crate's documentation; could generate an issue report. Pre-existing in the prior README (the convention sweep at ff48ff1 reshaped sections but kept this string verbatim). Trivial fix in a single docs commit.
title: README mis-cites RFC 6889 (NAT64) instead of RFC 9610 (JMAP Contacts)
